summary: Iteration 42: Verified homepage restructure, Professional dashboard restructure, and Judge portal + hearing-date feature. Backend: pytest tests/test_hearing_reminder.py + tests/test_court_workflow.py = 11/11 PASSED against preview URL (6.7s). Covers hearing_date store/visibility to pro & judge, invalid date -> 400, judge can PATCH, pro PATCH -> 403, run_hearing_reminders emails both pro + judge once (deduped via hearing_reminder_sent) and skips submitted, cron endpoint /api/cron/hearing-reminder -> 200 with Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET & 401 without, plus full court workflow (referral -> accept -> court-case -> statement (custody-language 400) -> submit-to-court (attest false 400 / true -> version 1 sha256 frozen), version 2 supersedes v1, status_summary current_status 'Ready for court review' + outdated flag after acknowledge, decline w/o reason 400, parent blocked 403). Brighter Futures.', hero-journey present, four-steps-list has exactly 6 children, court-pathway-section rendered with 8 court-step-* items, nav-for-courts href=#for-courts, 0 console errors, no horizontal overflow at 390px. (b) Pro dashboard (approval.test.pro1@gmail.com) — primary-actions-grid + tile-manage-case/invite-parents/review-reports/court-cases all present, tile-court-cases-count='2 new', secondary-tools visible, joint-reports-section 'Your Cases' contains ZERO case-row-sample-* rows, sample-reports-section contains the SAMPLE case-row (case-row-sample-7f03bb5a-…), court-referrals-inbox visible, more-tools is a <details> element collapsed by default (open=null) and after expanding shows ext-linked-block, agreement-tools-grid, fv-contact-card, enter-code-card, circle-nav-section is NOT rendered, mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow. Only console error is the expected pre-login /api/auth/me 401. (c) Judge portal (judge.ui.preview@sacoparentsalign.com) — refer-case form contains data-testid='refer-hearing-date'; created referral 2026-CI-UI<rand> with Albert W. Smith and hearing date; court-referral-row-<id> rendered with hearing-value-<id>='2026-09-23', court-field-pro-<id>/court-field-status-<id>/court-field-hearing-<id>/court-field-joint-<id>/court-field-submissions-<id>/court-field-audit-<id> labels present; hearing-edit-btn-<id> opens inline date input + Save/Cancel; save updates the value and re-renders. Pro inbox shows court-referral-hearing-<id> with 'Hearing 2026-10-20 · reminder one week before if not yet submitted' for the referral with a hearing date. Note: review request wrote testids as 'court-field-pro/status/hearing' but the implementation uses '-<id>' suffix (court-field-pro-<id>, etc.) — this is consistent across CourtCaseCard.jsx and works with prefix selectors.
